newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes down in stagnant market.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes down in stagnant market.

text.p: The Czech PX50 edged slightly lower in stagant trading on the Prague Stock Exchange on Friday with some dealers saying the index may still be overvalued.
The PX50 lost 0.3 points, 0.05 percent, to 551.1 and the major issue dominated RPIX fell 2.5 points, 0.22 percent, to 1,152.9.
"I really think that the market is still a bit overvalued. If I had to invest my money it would be in fixed income," said Radek Vavra of Citicorp Securities.
Vavra said Thursday's reduction of minimum reserve requirements to 9.5 percent from 11.5 percent would have little short term effect on banking stocks.
On the day, Komercni Banka lost early gains to close unchanged at 2,312, Ceska Sporitelna rose two crowns to 303 and IPB Bank rose 11 crowns to 320.
